title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. FIFTH STAIR PUSH UPS, SHORT SIDE PLANKS, AND HONEST CORE. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TUESDAY. TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE SHOULDERS, OWN THE BALANCE, HIT THE FIFTH STAIR, AND WAKE THAT DESK CORE. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THE KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE DONE. CHEST HONEST. CORE AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE POSTURE AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE STEP. FULL RANGE. SMOOTH AND HONEST. DO NOT DROP THE STEP UNTIL THIS HEIGHT IS EASY.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. BODY STRAIGHT. CHEST TO THE STEP. THIS IS YOUR PUSH WORK. DO NOT CHEAT THE RANGE LIKE A LAZY SOD DODGING PARADE.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND CLEAN. BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. DO NOT FORCE IT.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. SHORT AND CLEAN. THIS IS YOUR CORE WORK. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A WET TENT.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. BREATHE. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR CORE WORK. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED BEETLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET.
exercises.speakDone: DEAD BUGS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
